parsed.summary: The proposed change addresses the overflow issue by modifying the calculation of the Fowlkes-Mallows score. The change is minimal and focused on the identified problem.

issues.description: The change introduces an explicit type conversion to np.int64, which is not necessary for the fix and may not be consistent with the rest of the codebase.
